reconcile.note: Adam Clarke limits Paul's ban on fellowship with unbelievers to idolatrous worship and apostasy, not the ordinary social contact that the love-your-neighbor texts require.

sides.verseText: but you shall surely kill him; your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
